ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; surface is approximately 95 percent dark pigment with minor high-intensity focal spots near the notch and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark grey/black pigment across the majority of both lobes. High-contrast white mottling is clustered around the central notch area. Subtle greyish mottling is visible on the mid-section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree angle; depth is approximately 15 percent of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel amplitudes; most pronounced jaggedness occurs at the distal tips of both lobes; the inner trailing edge exhibits finer, more regular peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily linear sweep with slight upward concavity near the outer edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of small, roughly circular high-contrast white spots surrounding the median notch area; single high-intensity spot on the distal right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical dark linear marks are visible on the right lobe adjacent to the notch; multiple faint diagonal pixel disruptions are present on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular truncation and jagged erosion on both the left and right distal tips, indicating historical physical wear or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced contrast between the relatively smooth median notch edges and the heavily serrated distal lobe tips.
